name: Home page renders in the approved design
procedure: Open http://localhost:5173 as a guest; read loaded fonts and the wordmark's computed font
expected: EB Garamond and Source Sans 3 loaded; serif wordmark; 4 collection tiles; 4 fan favorites
actual: Fonts: EB Garamond, Source Sans 3; wordmark EB Garamond; 4 tiles; 4 fan favorites

name: Navigation for a guest
expected: Home, Products, About Us, Cart, Log In, Create Account
actual: Home, Products, About Us, Cart, Log In, Create Account

name: Products grid and card click
procedure: Open Products; count cards; click the first card
expected: 102 cards with image, name, price, description; click opens the item page
actual: 102 cards; first card '2025 Yale Vs Harvard T Shirt' $32 with image and 91-char description; landed on /products/2025-yale-vs-harvard-t-shirt with 6 size buttons

name: Size picker shows real stock and disables sold-out sizes
procedure: Open the Baseball Left Chest Crewneck page
expected: XS and XL 'Out of stock' and disabled; S pre-selected; M '5 left'; L and XXL '25 in stock'
actual: XS: Out of stock (disabled); S: 15 in stock (selected); M: 5 left; L: 25 in stock; XL: Out of stock (disabled); XXL: 25 in stock

name: Chat puts matching items on the page
procedure: Open the chat as a guest, ask 'Show me your fleeces', then click the second card in the 'Picked for you' strip
expected: Reply plus mini cards under it; the strip shows the same items; clicking a strip card opens that item and the chat context follows
actual: Reply '8 fleece matches…'; 8 mini cards; 8 strip cards visible at the top; clicked /products/divinity-school-fleece-sweater; item page opened; chat context 'Asking about: divinity school fleece sweater'

name: Language selector: Español
procedure: Choose Español in the chat header; ask '¿Cuánto cuesta esta y qué tallas hay?' on the Divinity School Fleece Sweater page; compare with the database
expected: Panel strings switch to Spanish; the choice is saved; Spanish reply with the real price and per-size stock
actual: Placeholder 'Pregunta sobre ropa de Yale…', button 'Enviar', pending 'Revisando el inventario…', saved 'es'. Reply: 'La Divinity School Fleece Sweater cuesta $98. Está en stock en XS (25), S (25), M (12), L (5), XL (12) y XXL (2). L y XXL tienen pocas unidades.' Database: $98; XS 25, S 25, M 12, L 5, XL 12, XXL 2

name: Create Account validation
procedure: Fill all five fields with a non-matching confirm password and submit
expected: Five fields present; 'Passwords don't match.' shown; nothing sent
actual: Fields present; error 'Passwords don't match.'; still on /create-account

name: About, unknown page, and Log In pages
expected: About with three ruled sections; friendly 404 message; login form with email and password
actual: 'About Us' with 3 sections; 'We couldn't find that page.'; 'Welcome back' with both fields

name: Log in through the form
procedure: Submit the login form as the test user
expected: Redirect home; nav shows Cart, Inventory, Hi Test, Log Out; utility row says Signed in as Test User
actual: Path /; nav Home, Products, About Us, Cart, Inventory, Hi Test, Log Out; 'Signed in as Test User'

name: Add to cart
procedure: On the Baseball crewneck page choose M, quantity 2, click Add to cart
expected: Confirmation with a cart link; nav badge 2
actual: 'Added 2 × Baseball Left Chest Crewneck (size M) to your cart.'; badge 2

name: Cart page totals and stock cap
procedure: Open Cart; read the line and total; type 9 in the quantity box (M has 5 in stock)
expected: Line $116, total $116; quantity snaps to 5, total $290, badge 5
actual: Row 'Size M · $58 each qty=2 line=$116', total $116; after typing 9: qty 5, total $290, badge 5

name: Checkout page
expected: Demo banner; contact pre-filled from the account; payment fields present; Place order disabled with a tooltip; summary lists the line
actual: Banner shown; first name Test, email test@campuscustoms.yale.edu; all four payment fields present; Place order disabled, title 'Ordering is disabled on this sample site'; summary '5 × Baseball Left Chest Crewneck (M) $290', total $290

name: Remove from cart
actual: 0 rows; 'Your cart is empty'; no badge

name: Owner page shows the numbers
expected: Title, low-stock table, activity table including this walkthrough's own events
actual: 'Inventory notes'; 260 low-stock rows; activity: Baseball Left Chest Crewneck 4 views / 0 clicks / 2 added; 2025 Yale Vs Harvard T Shirt 1 / 1 / 0; Divinity School Fleece Sweater 1 / 1 / 0

name: Run an inventory review from the page
procedure: Click 'Run inventory review'; wait for the summary
expected: Summary shown; up to 10 reorder notes appear as cards with real quantities
actual: 'Sent 10 reorder notes for the 10 products in this review queue…'; 10 open notes; first: Reorder, Ice Hockey Left Chest Hoodie, 'sold out in M, L, and XL (0 units, 0% of par each). Suggest ordering 25 of M, 25 of L, and 25 of XL…'

name: Log out
expected: Back home; nav returns to guest links
actual: Path /; nav Home, Products, About Us, Cart, Log In, Create Account
